steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Jihad means "struggle" or "striving" — NOT "holy war." There are two types: the greater jihad (internal spiritual struggle against sin) and the lesser jihad (external struggle, which may include armed combat under strict conditions). | Exam Tip: The vast majority of Muslims interpret jihad primarily as the greater jihad — the inner struggle. Terrorist attacks that kill civilians violate every condition of lesser jihad and are condemned by mainstream Islamic scholars. | RS Exam Tips — Jihad: 1. For Jihad questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3. Use specialist vocabulary precisely (e.g. terms from the specification) 4. Evaluate by analysing strengths and weaknesses of different views

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Explain the difference between greater and lesser jihad.
